observations.statement: Tall horns, swept layered hair, a fitted shirt-and-trouser line, a long quilted coat panel, cables, and the enormous rounded mechanical device create a broad asymmetric silhouette weighted heavily to one side.
White and charcoal-gray dominate, with black horns and gloves, sharp red at the eyes and tie, and antique gold or bronze across the belt, watch-like ornament, and machinery.
Layered white hair partly veils narrow red eyes and frames two large ridged black horns; the level mouth and sideward gaze read as alert, tired, and unsentimental rather than aggressive.

A high-collar white buttoned shirt with rolled sleeves and a loosened red tie is tucked into tailored high-waisted trousers, then equipped with a wide belt, suspenders or harness lines, shoulder-mounted hardware, a holster, fitted gloves, heeled shoes, and a trailing quilted coat or cape.
Crisp shirting, matte tailored cloth, padded gray lining, black leather-like gloves and belts, polished gold fittings, horn ridges, and heavy weathered metal are clearly differentiated.
observations.uncertainty: Material words describe rendered cues, not a physical-material measurement.

observations.statement: Workplace tailoring, clocks or circular medallions, gears, security hardware, red warning accents, vertical pinstripes, and horn curves repeat across body and equipment.

A huge articulated shield-, case-, or striking-device dominates the full-body art. Its exact mechanical function is not proven by these rasters, but its mass and the security harness make frontline protection unmistakable.
One hand rests on her hip while the other braces casually against the large device; squared shoulders and a slight lean project practiced competence with little performative enthusiasm.

The literal office shirt, loosened tie, security kit, clock-like ornaments, and workmanlike stance unusually closely echo the semantic profile of a long-serving Averardo Vault employee whose ambition is simply to clock out on time.
observations.uncertainty: The relationship between visible design and narrative meaning is analytical interpretation unless the cited text explicitly names the feature.

summary: Zani is a fantasy security professional rendered through office tailoring and overwhelming physical equipment. White hair, black ridged horns, red eyes, a rolled-sleeve white shirt, loose red tie, charcoal trousers, gloves, belts, radio-like hardware, and a massive bronze-gray shield/device make the 'best employee' look both exhausted by work and impossible to move.
